checks: The only input bindings are the accepted TRAIN cache, its independent audit, and the fixed student schedule; no DEV file is opened. All rows must be train and the 19 source identities remain within their unique groups.
Group hashes are computed from seed20261112 and source_group_id, sorted and round-robin assigned to five folds; the split is written before features/labels are loaded.
Means, standard deviations, zero-variance flags, Huber constant minimizer interval, and linear fit use fold-training tiles only. Held-out labels are used only for descriptive scoring.

The FP64 tile-local eleven-dimensional vector is the arithmetic mean of the two original feature slots. The loss is mean beta1 Huber plus half ridge .001 times squared slopes; the intercept is unregularized.

The gradient uses clipped residuals and ridge slopes. The largest eigenvalue of Z.T@Z/n+ridge diagonal bounds the Huber gradient Lipschitz constant, giving the fixed1/L step. There are exactly200 updates, no line search/threshold tuning or convergence claim.
The fold-training constant baseline solves both Huber minimizer interval endpoints with60 bisections and chooses the closest-to-zero minimizer. Exact/signed-zero score does not select K1.
Primary Huber comparison is equal-weighted across19 held-out sources. Tile micro and profile/source macro summaries are separate. Conditional rates explicitly include valid-source denominators.

Linux execution sets two-CPU affinity and BLAS thread environment before NumPy import,4GiB address-space limit, and180s SIGALRM; output is new-only, fixed small JSON and failure remains failed/no-retry.
limitations: These are head-fit held-out TRAIN groups; the fixed K1 teacher previously trained on all19 sources. This is not teacher/restorer-held-out or independent-test evaluation.
A linear per-tile slot mean omits the original3x3 context and nonlinear interactions; failure cannot establish that all raw-observation information is useless.
Normalized clipped utility Huber gain is not physical RGB MAE gain or restoration quality; no significance claim is made for correlated frames/tiles.
200 iterations do not certify an optimum. Runtime3.12.14/NumPy1.26.4 and Linux limits remain actual-execution gates; the read7/7 fixture receipt was produced locally with Python3.14.5/NumPy2.5.1.
CPU/array run not performed by this reviewer; no model, training, SSH or DEV-cache scan.
